notes: A staff schedule: each person's usual hours, and the Staff tab says who is running late, who didn't come in and who is still here after their shift.
Time off: staff ask from their card, managers approve, paid time off balances are kept, and paid time off is paid and in the payroll file.
Payroll files for Gusto, ADP Workforce Now and QuickBooks Online, in each one's own import format.
Students for each person working, now and hour by hour today, with an optional limit to be warned about.
A practice copy with made-up records, and a busy afternoon run across the center's computers that says whether they all agree.
Importing students starts with what it found in the file, and combines a child listed twice into one student unless you say they're two.
Connected devices says which phones and tablets connected today, and suggests renewing the connect code once a month.
Check-ins saved on a support while the main computer was away keep the time of the tap, not the time they were saved.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it over the old one; your records stay as they are.
